subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 2de · Grammaire · Relatives, passif et modaux
description: Règles et automatismes — relatives, passif et modaux.

cards.front: Complète : The activist ___ spoke was convincing.
cards.back: The activist who spoke was convincing.

cards.front: Complète : The writer ___ novel won the prize is Irish.
cards.back: The writer whose novel won the prize is Irish.

cards.front: Complète : This is the town ___ she grew up.
cards.back: This is the town where she grew up.

cards.front: Mets au passif : They built the bridge in 1890.
cards.back: The bridge was built in 1890.

cards.front: Mets au passif : We must protect wildlife.
cards.back: Wildlife must be protected.

cards.front: Traduis : « Cette solution pourrait fonctionner. »
cards.back: This solution might work.

cards.front: Traduis cette déduction : « Il doit être chez lui. »
cards.back: He must be at home.

cards.front: Traduis cette déduction : « Cela ne peut pas être vrai. »
cards.back: It can't be true.

cards.front: Relie avec although : It is useful. It is expensive.
cards.back: Although it is useful, it is expensive.

cards.front: Complète : ___ the rain, they continued.
cards.back: Despite the rain, they continued.
